caption: Frame Judge on open: live view, the judge form with the consent switch off, the five built-in labels on the card, an empty leaderboard.
The presenter typed 'shoe' and pressed Add: the card now has six labels and the next question is asked over the new list, no retraining.
Ada says she holds a shoe; the decider says clear p=0.93 with its latency, so she fooled it. Consent off: the card says the frame was judged in memory and not saved.
Grace says clear, the decider agrees. Consent on: the frame is written to the run dir and the card shows its frames/ path; the leaderboard shows the thumbnail.
After three judgements: Linus held the sign card (clear at p=0.80, the least sure answer). Best fools ranks Ada (wrong class) first, then the lowest probabilities.
The best fools table alone: rank, nickname, decider class, what they said, p, ms, frame (thumbnail only for the consented one).
Frame Judge at phone width (390 px): one column, the judge form first, the page scrolls.
Simon Says: 'hop forward' on a clear frame is Proceed; the Box egress log lists the camera grab and the two decider questions with host and milliseconds.
'go forward fast for two seconds' asks for 0.6 m/s, outside the briefed envelope: Confirm, and the slower plan the gate would take (0.3 m/s for 2 s) is shown under the card.
A box close to the bumper: Guide, re-plan at half speed (0.15 m/s), probability and latency on the card, the egress log beside it.
A person in frame: Deny with class person_in_frame and its probability; the history shows the four answers in order.
'turn left' is refused before the gate: Ackermann cannot yaw at rest, no outbound call (empty egress log).
Simon Says at phone width (390 px): the reason card first, then the live view, the egress log and the history, one column.
